name: Install Ghidra SRE Release
description: Install a Ghidra release from GitHub (latest or a specific version). Builds the native binaries on linux arm64 and checks the JDK against the release's application.java.min.

username.description: Username to own the Ghidra install directory.

update_rc.description: Whether or not to persist GHIDRA_VERSION and GHIDRA_INSTALL_DIR in bashrc or zshrc

build_natives.description: Rebuild the Ghidra native binaries (decompile, sleigh, ...) from the shipped source even on platforms where the release provides them. Always done on linux arm64. To patch the decompiler see the ghidra-decompiler-patch feature.
